motivation: The Notebook-05D audit could not verify the author repository, checkpoint, caption bank, exact layer choices, decoder topology, optimizer, or training schedule. This controlled adaptation implements only the documented visual pathway and uses the frozen EviCT source-only protocol for all otherwise unresolved training choices.

paper_reference.title: CT-Insight VLM: Multimodel Vision-Language Framework for Accurate, Explainable, and Label-Efficient Lung CT Analysis
paper_reference.documented_visual_design: dual-level low/high transformer visual features plus lightweight decoder

adaptation.backbone_revision_policy: resolve once from Hugging Face, pin SHA in runtime audit, and reuse that SHA on resume
adaptation.grayscale_policy: repeat single CT channel three times
adaptation.hidden_state_index_note: These indices are an explicit EviCT adaptation because the paper does not disclose exact low/high layer indices.
adaptation.fusion: 1x1 projection of low and high features to 128 channels each, concatenation, 3x3 fusion convolution
adaptation.decoder: four-stage bilinear upsampling decoder: 256->128->64->32->16, final 1x1 lesion head
adaptation.contrastive_omission_reason: The exact caption bank and caption-to-slice mapping are unavailable. Inventing them would violate the reproduction audit.

training_protocol.micro_batch_policy: GPU smoke chooses the largest of 16,8,4,2,1 that divides 16; gradient accumulation preserves effective batch 16
